# Load libraries
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(microbiomeMarker)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(readxl)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
```

# Setup
## Read in data
```{r}
kegg <- read_excel('Data/EMU_database.GIBBs.KO.PICRUST2.xlsx', sheet='EMU_database.GIBBs.PICRUSt2', range='B9:BE17565')
kegg <- kegg %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, replace_na, replace=0)

P.rel <- readRDS('phyloseq/P.Time.rel.RDS')
P.rel <- subset_samples(P.rel, Reads.16S > 10000)
```

# P decomposers
```{r}
wanted <- kegg[kegg$phoA > 0 | kegg$phoD > 0 | kegg$PHO > 0 | kegg$appA > 0 | kegg$phoN > 0 ,  ]$Species
P.sub <- subset_taxa(P.rel, Species %in% wanted)

P.glom <- tax_glom(P.sub, taxrank="Species")
P.glom <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(P.glom) > 0, P.glom)
pdecomp <- psmelt(P.glom) %>% 
  filter(., Abundance != 0)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

pdecomp <- pdecomp %>%
mutate(Stage = as_factor(Stage)) %>%
mutate(Stage = fct_relevel(Stage, "Seedling", "Early_Vegetative", "Late_Vegetative", "Early_Flower", "Late_Flower"))
table(pdecomp$Stage)

```

# Run model (log transform needed)
```{r}
mod <- lm(log(Abundance) ~  Stage*Fertilization*Domestication, data=pdecomp)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod)

Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Domestication ~ Stage | Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 

emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Domestication|Stage|Fertilization)
emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Stage, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Stage, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Stage), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=T)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Domestication, Stage, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Domestication', 'Stage'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```



### Data visualization
```{r}
p <- ggplot(aes(x=Stage, y=response), data = df) +
  geom_line(aes(color=Domestication, group=Domestication),
            stat='summary',fun='mean',size=1) +
  geom_errorbar(width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, 
                    group=Domestication,color=Domestication))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('darkblue','darkorange2'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -3, hjust = -0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Fertilization, ncol=2)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Phosphorus Decomposer Relative Abundance")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p
#ggsave(plot=p, 'output/p_decomposer.png', width = 12, height = 6)
```



# Select P solubilizer
```{r}
wanted <- kegg[kegg$pqqC > 0 ,  ]$Species
P.sub <- subset_taxa(P.rel, Species %in% wanted)

P.glom <- tax_glom(P.sub, taxrank="Species")
P.glom <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(P.glom) > 0, P.glom)
psol <- psmelt(P.glom) %>% 
  filter(., Abundance != 0)
psol <- psol %>%
mutate(Stage = as_factor(Stage)) %>%
mutate(Stage = fct_relevel(Stage, "Seedling", "Early_Vegetative", "Late_Vegetative", "Early_Flower", "Late_Flower"))
table(psol$Stage)

```


# Run model (log transform needed)
```{r}
mod <- lm(log(Abundance) ~  Stage*Fertilization*Domestication, data=psol)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod)

Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Domestication ~ Stage | Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 

emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Domestication|Stage|Fertilization)
emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Stage, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Stage, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Stage), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=T)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Domestication, Stage, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Domestication', 'Stage'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```


### Data visualization
```{r}
p <- ggplot(aes(x=Stage, y=response), data = df) +
  geom_line(aes(color=Domestication, group=Domestication),
```
